en:
To save Kanayama Castle, besieged
by Ouchi Yoshitaka's Ouchi Army,
the Amago lords gathered under
Amago Haruhisa's command: Kikkawa
Mototsune and his brother Tsuneyo,
Kagawa Mitsukage, Mouri Motonari.
Among them was Kumagai Nobunao,
who had a bitter past with the Mouri.

note: 'alongside us' made explicit: the point is that the Mouri must fight next to the son of the man they killed.

en:
Even with Motonari as clan head,
the Amago and the Ouchi kept up
their standoff.
Meanwhile, aided by Fukubara,
Shiji and others, Motonari
established a firm rule over his lands.
Then, a year later,
the first to make a move
was Ouchi Yoshioki.

Ouchi Yoshitaka left Konomine
and laid siege to Kanayama Castle.
Takeda Mitsukazu readied his
defenses and sent envoys to the
Amago to ask for reinforcements.
